name: Docker 管理
author: ServerDeck
description: 管理 Docker 容器与镜像，查看详情、日志并打开容器终端。

args: export LC_ALL=C; export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; unset DOCKER_HOST DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH; sd_uid=$(id -u); sd_socket=/var/run/docker.sock; if test -S /run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; then sd_socket=/run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; fi; d() { command docker --host unix://$sd_socket "$@"; }; if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '{"dockerInstalled":false,"dockerState":"absent"}'; else d version --format '{{json .}}'; fi

export LC_ALL=C; export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; unset DOCKER_HOST DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH; sd_uid=$(id -u); sd_socket=/var/run/docker.sock; if test -S /run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; then sd_socket=/run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; fi; d() { command docker --host unix://$sd_socket "$@"; }; d container ls --all --no-trunc --format '{{json .}}'

export LC_ALL=C; export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin; unset DOCKER_HOST DOCKER_CONTEXT DOCKER_TLS_VERIFY DOCKER_CERT_PATH; sd_uid=$(id -u); sd_socket=/var/run/docker.sock; if test -S /run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; then sd_socket=/run/user/$sd_uid/docker.sock; fi; d() { command docker --host unix://$sd_socket "$@"; }; d image ls --all --no-trunc --digests --format '{{json .}}'
